query: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security | stats count by src_ip | where count > 10

commands.name: search
commands.description: Base event filter using field criteria (EventCode=4625 and sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security) against the wineventlog index

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Aggregates events by counting occurrences grouped by the src_ip field

commands.name: where
commands.description: Filters the aggregated results to include only groups where the count exceeds the threshold of 10

functions.name: count
functions.description: Aggregation function that counts the number of events in each group

summary: This Splunk query searches the wineventlog index for Windows failed authentication events (EventCode 4625) with sourcetype WinEventLog:Security. It aggregates the events using a count function grouped by source IP address (src_ip) and filters the results to display only source IPs that have generated more than 10 failed authentication attempts within a 1-hour sliding window. The output provides a list of suspicious source IPs ranked by the number of failed login attempts they initiated.
intent: Detect brute-force login attacks against Windows hosts by identifying source IP addresses that exceed a threshold of failed authentication attempts within a defined time window.
use_case: Security monitoring for brute-force attack detection on Windows domain-joined systems. Used in a detection alert workflow to automatically trigger notifications when source IPs exhibit authentication patterns consistent with credential-stuffing or password-spray attacks.
